title: Newhalo scroll reveal
description: CSS-only scroll-driven reveals: fade, a 60px or 50px rise, a 1.15→1 zoom, a scrubbed 1.1→1 bloom, a soft left-to-right text wipe, hairlines that draw in from the left, and a parallax drift for pictures inside their frames. Staggers by shifting each item's range a little later.
notes: uses animation-timeline: view(); browsers without it, and reduced motion, show everything in place
use the wrapper, or put newhaloReveal(effect) and newhaloRevealStyle(step) on your own element
crop drifting pictures with overflow-clip, not overflow-hidden
name: newhalo-reveal

props.name: effect
props.description: what happens as it enters the window

props.name: step
props.description: stagger position in a list: each step starts a little later

props.name: drift
props.description: for drift: how far the content slides each way, in px
